description: This file defines the Opencart	extbarSystem	extbarLibrary	extbarCache	extbarFile class, which implements caching mechanisms using the file system. It provides methods to get, set, and delete cache entries, as well as automatic cleanup in its destructor.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Provides file-based caching with get, set, delete, and cleanup functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the cache with an optional expiration time.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached value by key, decoding JSON stored in cache files.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in cache with an associated key and expiration time, encoding it as JSON.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes cache files corresponding to the specified key.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Performs cleanup of expired cache files during object destruction, with probabilistic cleanup of all cache files.
